eyebrow: The one shaping approach with a real guarantee
code:
def shaped_reward(raw_reward, state, next_state, gamma=0.99):
    phi_s = potential(state)        # e.g. how many required sub-steps are done
    phi_next = potential(next_state)
    shaping = gamma * phi_next - phi_s
    return raw_reward + shaping
caption: Doesn't change the optimal policy — but only if Φ depends on state alone, never on the action taken
